mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification_codes (email, purpose, code, attempts, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{purpose}, #{code}, #{attempts}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM email_verification_codes WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM email_verification_codes WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
